name: Nature’s Burden
body:
You have been charged by spirits and have to take upon yourself the weight of this task.

Prerequisite(s): Charged by nature class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain an oracle’s curse. You treat your inquisitor levels as oracle levels for the purpose of determining your curse’s advancement.
